genetic variants of vitamin D binding protein (DBP), a protein that transports vitamin D, are not associated with type 1 diabetes in French Caucasians.
the Asp416Glu and Thr420Lys polymorphisms of the DBP are not associated with type 1 diabetes in French Caucasians.
the Asp --> Glu and Thr --> Lys polymorphisms in the vitamin D binding protein (DBP; also called Gc globulin) are not associated with type 1 or type 2 DM.
